title: Book My Space
body: Book My Space is a responsive and interactive office space rental web application built using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The platform enables workspace providers to register and list their coworking spaces, private offices, meeting rooms, and conference halls, while users can conveniently explore and book spaces tailored to their needs. With a modern and intuitive UI, the application features a sticky transparent navbar, dynamic search bar, location-based filters, and smooth navigation across sections such as Home, About, Services, Workspaces, Pricing, Blog, and Pages. Users can book spaces on an hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly basis, selecting their preferred location, date & time, number of occupants, and amenities, with real-time pricing updates.

title: Travela
body: Travela Booking System is a responsive and interactive tour booking web application built using React.js and React Bootstrap. The platform allows users to explore a wide range of travel destinations and conveniently book tour packages. It features a visually appealing UI with a carousel, search bar, destination highlights, and an easy-to-use booking form. Users can select their preferred destination, date & time, number of persons, and get instant pricing. The site includes sections like Home, About, Services, Packages, Blog, and a Pages dropdown, along with a sticky transparent navbar and smooth navigation. The application ensures a seamless user experience across all screen sizes, making it ideal for users planning their next vacation.

title: Male Fashion
body: Male Fashion is a modern full-stack e-commerce web application built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js). The platform is designed for stylish men's fashion, offering a smooth and engaging shopping experience. It features a clean and responsive UI developed with React and Bootstrap, showcasing a wide range of fashion products like shirts, jackets, and accessories. Users can browse items, add products to the cart or wishlist, filter by size or price, and securely proceed to checkout. Admin functionality includes adding, editing, and managing products. With MongoDB as the database and secure API integrations, the application ensures seamless user management and persistent data storage. The project highlights dynamic routing, user authentication, and a strong focus on UI/UX for fashion-centric online shopping.

title: Chat Verse
body:
This Node.js command-line application generates an interactive team dashboard from user-provided data. It accepts information about team members and outputs a dynamic HTML page profiling the entire group.
Rather than relying on static spreadsheets, this tool creates a customizable web page that brings employee data to life. The dashboard auto-populates with profiles for each team member, containing details provided via the command-line input.
Built on Node.js, this project demonstrates skills in crafting web applications using JavaScript-based server-side frameworks. It handles input data dynamically to render an animated, engaging profile of the entire team. The end result is an shareable HTML page that serves as a creative alternative to traditional spreadsheet-based team overviews.
